items.name: The rim goes dark
items.description: Anchors cut the rim systems off. Origin: the system farthest from Haven.

items.name: The major lanes fall
items.description: Main trade lanes collapse; refugees and price spikes.

items.name: The galaxy splits
items.description: The galaxy breaks into isolated pockets.

items.name: Home is enclosed
items.description: The human region is sealed. Everyone knows at once.

items.name: Captain finds an artifact
items.description: The captain recovers a Firstborn artifact from a ruin. Origin: that system.

items.name: "Return to me"
items.description: Mother's first transmission, heard on every band at once. Fired by story code (not yet built).

items.name: An Anchor wakes
items.description: The first Anchor station activates and severs a route. Fired by story code (not yet built).
